content: ADR-010 third-party activation targets: 15 targets covered by transitional package-shipped units (feralos-aports 44c598a) — avahi, udisks2, geoclue, cups-pk-helper, kcron (system); goa-daemon + goa-identity-service, evolution-data-server x4 (Sources5/AddressBook10/Calendar8/UserPrompter0), GNOME Calendar/DiskUtility/Firmware/Maps (session). Exact Exec/lifecycle verified on Alpine 3.24 (avahi upstream Exec=/bin/false systemd-only -> unit runs foreground; UDisks2 /usr/libexec/udisks2/udisksd; geoclue 60s idle exit kept; kcron KAuth helper short-lived; GNOME apps --gapplication-service; GOA two binaries). Harness NEW dbus_activation_units_live (real UDisks2+goa activation, no DBUS_STARTER_*) + dbus_activation_migration (AND gate: dbus-broker installed AND every activation target unit-covered; enumerates all activation files live; aliases count via override->existing unit). Validated 108/108 dinit (2026-10-20T21-22-46Z, 0/64 uncovered) + 92/92 OpenRC (21-30-15Z, 8/64 dinit-only expected).
